entries.title: First Confiscation Act
entries.summary: Congress authorized confiscation of property used for insurrectionary purposes and specified forfeiture of claims to the labor of people required or permitted to serve hostile military purposes.
entries.effectiveDateStatus: HOLD: separate implementation date not established

entries.title: First Legal Tender Act
entries.summary: Congress authorized United States notes with legal-tender status and specified exceptions for customs duties and interest on federal bonds and notes. Authorization is not an emission or price index.
entries.effectiveDateStatus: HOLD: separate implementation date not established

entries.title: Federal cooperation with gradual state emancipation
entries.summary: Lincoln recommended federal cooperation with a state choosing gradual abolition; the subsequent chamber votes are separate records. A signature date and completed state adoption are not supplied by this row.

entries.title: Additional Article of War
entries.summary: Congress prohibited military and naval personnel from employing their forces to return people escaping slavery, with dismissal after a court-martial conviction.

entries.title: District of Columbia Emancipation Act
entries.summary: Congress ended slavery in the District and established distinct compensation and consent-dependent colonization provisions. No human price or player stock is drafted.
entries.effectiveDateStatus: HOLD: separate implementation date not established

entries.title: Homestead Act
entries.summary: Congress prescribed entry and eventual patent conditions for specified public lands. Entry begins on 1 January 1863; the signature is not a November 1862 grant of farms or output.

entries.title: Freedom in federal territories
entries.summary: Congress prohibited slavery and involuntary servitude in existing and future federal territories, except as punishment after conviction. This jurisdiction is distinct from a state.
entries.effectiveDateStatus: HOLD: separate implementation date not established

entries.title: Additional United States notes
entries.summary: Congress authorized an additional issue of United States notes. Keep this authority separate from the February issue and later 1863 legislation.
entries.effectiveDateStatus: HOLD: separate implementation date not established

entries.title: Explanatory resolution for the Second Confiscation Act
entries.summary: Congress limited the specified state-office clause and barred construing punishment or proceedings as forfeiting real estate beyond the offender’s natural life.
entries.effectiveDateStatus: HOLD: separate implementation date not established

entries.title: Militia Act of 1862
entries.summary: Congress amended militia and military-service authorities, including provisions concerning people of African descent. This is chapter 201, separate from confiscation chapter 195.
entries.effectiveDateStatus: HOLD: separate implementation date not established

entries.title: Second Confiscation Act
entries.summary: Congress enacted distinct punishment, property, freedom and military-service provisions. Read the explanatory resolution with the act; no general population resource is authorized here.
entries.effectiveDateStatus: HOLD: separate implementation date not established

entries.title: Preliminary Emancipation Proclamation
entries.summary: Lincoln gave notice of freedom on 1 January 1863 for people enslaved in states or designated parts then in rebellion, with the stated executive recognition and maintenance. Congress was in recess; no September passage tally is supplied.
entries.effectiveDateStatus: conditional future date; not universal immediate freedom

rules: [I] These are historical reference ledger records, not ledger-act effects, player text or mandatory situation events.
[I] A chamber vote does not automatically authorize an executive policy, spend money or implement a law.
Unknown votes are null, not zero; no division does not mean a unanimous roll call.
Dates belong to the action, not the scan publication or the later compilation.
No party support coefficient, persuasion weight, calendar trigger or gate signature is supplied.
